title: Sparkly light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE0'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFE96A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F5B800'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer soft glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='30' fill='#3A3200' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='#5C4E00' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- bulb glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- inner filament glow highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='33' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- filament -->
  <path d='M44 50 L44 42 Q47 38 50 42 Q53 46 56 42 L56 50' fill='none' stroke='#E07B00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- neck of bulb -->
  <rect x='42' y='58' width='16' height='6' rx='2' fill='#C9D6E0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='58' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#EAF2F8'/>
  <!-- screw base -->
  <rect x='43' y='64' width='14' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#9AA7B2'/>
  <rect x='43' y='68' width='14' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#B7C3CD'/>
  <rect x='43' y='72' width='14' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#9AA7B2'/>
  <rect x='46' y='76' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7E8B96'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFF6B0'>
    <path d='M78 18 L80 24 L86 26 L80 28 L78 34 L76 28 L70 26 L76 24 Z'/>
    <path d='M20 22 L21.5 26 L26 27.5 L21.5 29 L20 33 L18.5 29 L14 27.5 L18.5 26 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 52 L85 55 L88 56 L85 57 L84 60 L83 57 L80 56 L83 55 Z'/>
    <path d='M14 52 L15 55 L18 56 L15 57 L14 60 L13 57 L10 56 L13 55 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFD84A'>
    <circle cx='66' cy='12' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='14' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='36' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='38' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='68' r='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
